name: File manager
title: Your vault is a folder.
description: Browse real folders and open the notes, code and attachments inside them.

name: Editor
title: Write with a single slash.
description: Bring up commands for the next block without leaving your note.

name: IDE
title: Keep the source beside the result.
description: Edit HTML and CSS in split panes, with the rendered page underneath.

name: Spaces
title: Bring related work together.
description: Keep a tree of related material beside two notes, tabs and split panes.

name: Spotlight
title: Find your next move.
description: Jump to notes, commands and views from one keyboard-driven search.

name: Topology
title: Give your notes a shared language.
description: Design note types, properties and connections in a visual schema editor.

name: Kanban
title: See the plan. Open the full story.
description: Move notes through your workflow, with their context one click away.

name: Calendar
title: Put your notes on the calendar.
description: See dated notes and external iCal feeds alongside your daily context.

name: Discovery
title: Give your notes another dimension.
description: Explore nested rows alongside typed properties, filters and sorting.

name: Graph
title: See the connections.
description: Explore the links between notes, people, projects and tasks in your vault.

name: RSS
title: Keep what matters.
description: Follow feeds and supported newsletters, read articles, and keep tags, stars and reactions.

name: Journal
title: Make a little room to reflect.
description: A dedicated writing view, entry history and a year of activity. This vault is ready for its first entry.

name: Chatbot
title: Ask your vault.
description: Use your chosen AI provider to find context, understand notes and organise information.

name: Dashboards
title: Make a front page that works for you.
description: Bring notes, bookmarks and recent activity into your own widget layout.

name: Sharing
title: Share the right context.
description: Choose read, write or dictation access, set an expiry, and revoke a link when you’re done.

name: Settings
title: Use the parts that help you.
description: Enable optional features and configure the workspace separately for each vault.

name: Encrypted notes
title: Keep a private document private.
description: Encrypt a note’s content while its title, properties and attachments remain separate.

name: Encrypted blocks
title: Lock just the sensitive part.
description: Use safe blocks inside ordinary notes, including password and OTP blocks.
